title: Transposition of the canonical base-change component for a single open
statement: Fix derived module categories on every scheme. Let $g:X\prime\to X$ be any scheme morphism, $W\subseteq X$ any open, $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $K\prime\in D(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and $\psi:Lg^*K\to K\prime$. Use the pinned adjunction, base-change map and pullback/open comparison of [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components]. Put $H_W=Rj_{W*}r_W$ and $H\prime_W=Rj_{g^{-1}W,*}r_{g^{-1}W}$, and use $c_W: Rg_*H\prime_W(K\prime)\cong H_W(Rg_*K\prime)$ from [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. The $g$-adjunction transpose of the canonical open component $Lg^*H_W(K)\to H\prime_W(K\prime)$ is $H_W(\operatorname{adj}_g(\psi))$ followed by $c_W^{-1}$. There is no cover, boundary, shift, flatness or quasi-coherence hypothesis.

proof.text: Postcompose the desired equality with the hom of the invertible canonical open comparison. Both maps now target Rj_W of the restriction of Rg(Kprime). Precomposition with the old-open unit is injective on maps into this right adjoint: transpose under exact restriction and cancel restriction of the unit, which is an isomorphism by the cited node. Reuse the existing private precomp_rightAdjoint_injective from DerivedBaseChangeOpenRestriction (proof-only import all) for this elementary cancellation; no new helper statement is introduced.

Naturality of the g Hom equivalence replaces precomposition by the old-open unit with pullback of that unit before the open component. Apply mvOpenBaseChange_unit to identify this composite with psi followed by the new-open unit. Hom-equivalence naturality on the right turns its transpose into the transpose of psi followed by Rg of the new-open unit. The proved schemeMVOpenComparison_unit then identifies its composite with the comparison hom as the transpose of psi followed by the old-open unit at Rg(Kprime).

The right-hand path after the same precomposition is the same expression by naturality of the old-open unit. Cancel precomposition using step 1, and cancel the invertible comparison hom. Empty opens, top opens and zero psi require no extra argument.

theorem derivedBaseChange_open_transpose
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : X' ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (ψ : (derivedPullback g).obj K ⟶ K') :
    (mvDerivedPullbackAdjunction g).homEquiv
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι).obj
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X' (g ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K'))
      (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap W.ι (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι g
          (g.resLE W (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl) (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι g le_rfl)
          ((schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map
          ((mvPullbackOpenRestrictionIso g W).inv.app K ≫
            (schemeOpenRestriction X' (g ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapDerivedCategory.map ψ)) =
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι).map
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((mvDerivedPullbackAdjunction g).homEquiv K K' ψ)) ≫
        (schemeMVOpenComparison g W K').inv
